name: Light Tunnel
description: Full-size WebGL2 background of glowing cables converging into a tunnel, with light pulses racing along them, optional mouse steering, click surge, intro reveal, and a light-mode ink rendering.
contents: Container div holding a single absolutely positioned WebGL2 canvas
Fragment shader drawing radial cables, pulses, glow, tunnel body, and optional grain
behavior: Cables and pulses flow inward or outward, with slow drift, sway, and bend over time
Tunnel steers gently toward the pointer while it is over the page
Click or tap fires a surge ring that travels along the tunnel
Intro reveals the tunnel from the center over about 1.8 seconds
Pauses rendering when off screen or tab hidden, and stops motion with prefers-reduced-motion
Canvas resolution follows container size with pixel ratio capped at 2
editableByProps: Cable, pulse, and tunnel colors, opacity, brightness, glow, and optional grain
Flow direction, speed, pulse speed, length, width, density, and blend
Cable count, thickness, waviness, sway, bend, size, and tunnel center offset
Mouse steering, click surge, intro, light mode for bright pages, random seed through variation
Container size and placement through className and style

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the surge speed or duration
needsCodeEdit.where: surge handling in the render function (travel, surgeLevel) and the surge.age < 2.4 checks

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the fragment look such as cable shape or pulse falloff

fixed: Requires WebGL2, renders nothing if the context or shader fails
Fills its parent, so the parent needs a defined height
Pointer and click listeners are attached to window, so mouse steering and surge react to the whole page, not only the container
Click surge triggers only when the click lands inside the container
Respects prefers-reduced-motion by freezing motion, intro, steering, and surge
Canvas is aria-hidden and purely decorative
Numeric props are clamped internally, for example cableCount 4 to 200 and opacity 0 to 1
Default colors are all white, so it needs a dark background unless lightMode is on
Pulse spacing and surge width are hardcoded in the shader uniforms
